ModMetaData.name: Lizarb Interface
ModMetaData.author: Lizarb
ModMetaData.description:
A complete reskin of RimWorld's interface.
- Presets: one click sets the textures, the typeface and its sizes, the text outline, the background pattern and how the Architect menu is coloured - Two presets can share one texture set and still read completely differently - Save your own, or drop a folder of art into Skins and it shows up on its own - Texture sets, hand painted and Legacy, each with its own palette, corner geometry and ornament - Window frames, tabs, buttons, tooltips, checkboxes, gizmos, scrollbars
Compatibility: this mod replaces the drawing of tabs, window backgrounds and menu sections rather than adding to them. Another mod that redraws those same surfaces will lose whichever of the two loads first, so load this one last if you want its look to win. Buttons, windows, tabs, widgets and scrollbars can each be turned off on their own, so a clash costs one checkbox instead of the whole skin.
Fonts ship with the mod under the SIL Open Font License. Full credits and licence files are included. The icons come from the Game Icon Pack v1.4 by Nieobie, released under CC0.
Built with AI: the code was written with Claude, Anthropic's assistant, with me directing and testing. No image AI made the art. The Legacy skins were drawn by a script from shapes and maths, the hand painted ones by me.
Source: https://github.com/dequevedo/lizarb-interface
